statusLine.command: export GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0; E=$(printf '\033'); i=$(cat); j() { echo "$i" | jq -r "$1 // empty"; }; d=$(j .workspace.current_dir); [ -z "$d" ] && d=$(j .cwd); m=$(j .model.display_name); c=$(j .context_window.used_percentage); h=$(j .rate_limits.five_hour.used_percentage); w=$(j .rate_limits.seven_day.used_percentage); b=; r=$(git -C "$d" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$r" ]; then b=$(git -C "$d" branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); [ -z "$b" ] && b=$(git -C "$d" rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null); else r=$d; fi; f=$(cd "$r" 2>/dev/null && find . -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 2 \( -name .git -o -name 'build*' -o -name node_modules -o -name target -o -name .venv \) -prune -o -type f -print 2>/dev/null | head -3000); e=$(echo "$f" | sed -n 's/.*\.\([A-Za-z0-9]*\)$/\1/p' | sort -u); n=0; L=; a() { [ $n -lt 5 ] && L="${L:+$L,}$1" && n=$((n+1)); true; }; x() { echo "$e" | grep -qxE "$1"; }; k() { echo "$f" | grep -qE "$1"; }; if x 'cpp|cc|cxx|hpp|hh'; then a cpp; elif x 'c|h'; then a c; fi; k '(^|/)CMakeLists\.txt($)' && a cmake; { x rs || k '(^|/)Cargo\.toml($)'; } && a rs; { x go || k '(^|/)go\.mod($)'; } && a go; { x py || k '(^|/)pyproject\.toml($)'; } && a py; { x 'ts|tsx' || k '(^|/)tsconfig\.json($)'; } && a ts; x 'js|jsx|mjs|cjs' && a js; x lua && a lua; x zig && a zig; x odin && a odin; x sh && a sh; x fish && a fish; x qml && a qml; sep="${E}[38;2;108;112;134m | ${E}[0m"; out=; seg() { out="${out:+$out$sep}${E}[38;2;$1m$2${E}[0m"; }; [ -n "$m" ] && seg '203;166;247' "$m"; [ -n "$b" ] && seg '166;227;161' "$b"; [ -n "$c" ] && seg '137;180;250' "ctx $(printf '%.0f' "$c")%"; [ -n "$h" ] && seg '250;179;135' "5h $(printf '%.0f' "$h")%"; [ -n "$w" ] && seg '249;226;175' "7d $(printf '%.0f' "$w")%"; [ -n "$L" ] && seg '148;226;213' "$L"; printf '%s\n' "$out"
